glosses: to drink or take a sip from an overfull glass or container

examples.text: Nachdem ich etwas von meinem Glas abgetrunken hatte, konnte ich es tragen ohne etwas zu verschütten.
examples.translation: After I had taken a sip from my glass, I was able to carry it without spilling something.
examples.english: After I had taken a sip from my glass, I was able to carry it without spilling something.
